name: 40475 · Richmond, KY
findings: ZIP 40475 (Richmond) has 204 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 82 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40475 (Richmond) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
